2027 Agenda

Eight themes shaping the next era of AI. The full program is being built now. Explore what's coming to AIS 2027, or apply to take the stage.

Get Tickets Apply to Speak
2027 Aug 11–13 WED – FRI COEX Grand Ballroom & Hall B, Seoul
2 daysConference · Aug 11–12
3 daysExpo · Aug 11–13
70+Conference sessions
8Key themes

Key themes for 2027

From frontier models to the factory floor, AIS 2027 follows AI from research to real-world deployment. Sessions and speakers will be announced in the coming months.

01

Frontier AI & Next Models

Foundation models, reasoning and multimodal systems: what comes after today's frontier, and what it means for business.

02

Enterprise AI & Agents

Agentic workflows moving from pilot to production, and how enterprises are redesigning work around AI agents.

03

AI Infrastructure & Future Compute

Chips, data centers, cloud and on-device inference: the compute stack powering the next wave of AI.

04

Physical AI & Robotics

Humanoids, cobots and autonomous systems: AI that sees, moves and acts in the real world.

05

AI-Native Business & Ecosystem

Startups, investors and new business models built around AI from day one.

06

AI Trust, Security & Sovereignty

Safety, governance, security and sovereign AI that organizations and nations can rely on.

07

AI for Industry

Manufacturing, finance, healthcare, retail and the public sector: real deployments with measurable outcomes.

08

AI for Science

AI accelerating discovery across materials, biology, climate and space research.

Share your AI vision. Inspire the future.

AI Summit Seoul & Expo 2027 brings together global AI leaders, innovators and decision-makers to explore the next frontier of AI. We invite experts to present breakthrough technologies, real-world use cases and forward-looking insights.
